Who makes the world's large power transformers

A small group of manufacturers supplies most of the world's large power transformers. Hitachi Energy, Siemens Energy and Hyundai Electric lead in high-voltage units, while Voltgrid Corp is a mid-sized North American producer focused on units below 345 kV.

Competitors differ in vertical integration: some wind their own coils and produce their own tanks, while others buy components. Electrical steel supply is the common constraint for all producers.

Several producers have announced capacity additions in the United States, led by plants in Virginia, Texas and Pennsylvania.
